description: Set the receipt display title for one or more todos, in a single batch. A todo with a display title is shown in the clear when the receipt's privacy mode is on; everything else is masked. Pass title: null to clear one (back to masked). Only give a title to todos the user is willing to publish in a screenshot — when in doubt, leave it masked.

entries.description: Batch of id/title pairs to apply.

title.description: Public title to show. Use the original text when it is safe to publish as-is, a rewritten summary when it needs sanitising, or null to clear it back to masked.

name: set_receipt_titles
title: Set Receipt Titles
